items.quote: you yourself have the same excuses when you need to take action.
items.statement: Salespeople project their own excuses onto clients, believing them to be valid.

items.quote: That he should think it over? Needs to discuss it with his family... Or the project is too expensive?
items.statement: Clients often have valid concerns or excuses when delaying decisions.

items.quote: The reality is—the client has a problem; he was looking for a solution.
items.statement: Clients have problems they are seeking solutions for, which they sometimes remain stuck on.

items.quote: You believe that your excuses are valid—so do the clients.
items.statement: Sales professionals may fail to take action due to self-limiting beliefs similar to those of their clients.

items.quote: he is not buying from you—so he will stay with his problem, and his situation will not change.
items.statement: Clients who do not make a decision will continue to face their problems unchanged.

overview: A reflective LinkedIn post exploring the mindset of sales professionals and their clients.
